implementation_notes: Write the protocol against loom's atomics and let loom::model explore every interleaving of a small state space. This is how the memory-ordering bug that passes a million unit-test runs is actually found, and it is the single highest-value tool in this pattern's toolchain.
code_sketch: loom::model(|| { /* two variables, two threads, assert the invariant */ });
pitfalls: Combinatorial explosion if the state space grows.
Only proves the modelled protocol, not the real workload.

variants.name: Crossbeam maintained structures
variants.idiom_name: crossbeam_queue SegQueue / MsQueue, crossbeam_epoch for reclamation
variants.implementation_notes: Production use means a maintained, audited implementation with documented progress guarantees (SegQueue is lock-free bounded; MsQueue is unbounded and lock-free; crossbeam-epoch provides epoch-based reclamation). The right default over hand-rolling.
pitfalls: Read each type's documented guarantee; they differ.
Epoch reclamation needs pinning on the thread.
